page_template: Place the tile at 1:1 scale on a sheet supported by the actual machine, then trim if needed. Do not assume a 100 mm card can be fed directly.
review: A source change or process change requires fresh proof hashes, individual visual inspection, device-output inspection and touch review.
source_concepts: Keep stable edu./aac. concept IDs and meaning-specific category paths. Collage geometry is reference material, not proof of process compatibility.
method: ViewPlus graphics with explicit height roles
semantic_encoding: Separate geometry from named height roles: background, area, principal-line and point. Assign tested device levels only after calibration.
reference_specs: Current Delta page lists 100 DPI positioning and minimum dot spacing 1/17 inch (about 1.49 mm). Traditional Tiger and TigerPlus modes differ. Do not rasterise a 100 DPI grid into equally close physical dots.
height_count_note: Current marketing says eight heights; TSS 7 documents white/zero plus seven nonzero graphic levels. Confirm the selected model and driver palette; do not treat eight advertised levels as eight independently discriminable raised heights.
controls: Exact model, Tiger/TigerPlus mode, driver/version and paper
Explicit height mapping; inversion, brightness, contrast and enhancement settings
Line/area distinction by touch, no paper damage, stable output on repeat copies
limitations: Begin with one raised level for simple shapes. Add a second raised level only when it serves the learning task. Height levels are device codes, not guaranteed millimetres or natural colour meanings.
actual_svg_encoding: Rendered fill and stroke grayscale drives the ViewPlus print mapping; semantic height-role attributes alone do not set embossed height. Selective area fills are documented in instructions/VIEWPLUS-SHADING.txt; actual device heights remain uncalibrated.
